fields.title: Published dimple limits are interpolations; direct roots are tighter
fields.evidence: Card elastic/outer-face/core-typical/core-minimum amplitudes are 5.823329047944/1.271068488423/2.377335243900/1.802745695209 mm. Independent direct coarse-mesh roots are 5.775402642639/1.221966307286/2.299766860540/1.763033119832 mm. All remain conditional elastic-model diagnostics.
fields.proposed_fix: Label interpolation explicitly. Use direct solves with diagnostic and mesh conventions pinned; do not promote either set to a manufacturing allowable.

claim: Published dimple limits are interpolations; direct roots are tighter
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
